pre-wrap

This text keeps its spaces and its line breaks, but is also allowed to wrap when a line is longer than the box, which makes it handy for user-submitted comments and log messages. An indented line stays indented.

pre-line

Spaces collapse here, but newlines survive. A blank line above makes a gap, and a really long line like this one will wrap at the edge of the container like normal text.

nowrap

This sentence never wraps, so it is clipped by its box instead.
